notes: Palette: 11 census clusters; capped at 8 by weight. Dropped: #000000cc (68; background; e.g. #container-bec52d3c6f > div > div:nth-of-type(1) > div > div > ol > li:nth-of-type(1) on ca-en-html); #000000 (56; button-text/text; e.g. #accordion-ac68ae73b1 > div:nth-of-type(1) > h3 > button on ca-en-faqs-html); #cccccc (2; border; e.g. main > div > div > div > section > form > div > input on us-en-ai-powered-search-html).
Radius: home-only and cross-page agree that the dominant visual radius is 0; cross-page adds 30px (article byline avatars) — see motifs.homeVsCrossPage.
CSS references 30+ custom properties (--brandPrimary, --textColor, --fontSizeH1 …) only as var() fallbacks; none is defined on any page (records customProps = {} ×65, census customProps empty).
Gradients: census found none (it does not read pseudo-elements); the one deployed gradient (members-only lock corner) is cited from the stylesheet.
Media harvest: 259 unique canonical sources (media.imgs + DOM img src/srcset, data-cmp-src, inline style backgrounds; AEM .coreimg rendition selectors collapsed), 0 failures; see _index.tsv.
Fonts: every loaded face is covered locally; files verified byte-identical to their source URLs.
Header and footer each have three variants (en-US, en-CA, coming-soon locale placeholder); see systemComponents.

Adventure detail pages come in two DOM sub-templates of 8 trips each (×2 locales): single-image vs multi-slide gallery carousel, components with vs without aem-GridColumn wrappers; the rendered module set is the same.
